# Milestone M1: one-arm bench kit (generated by `python -m rnd.m1_kit`)

**≈ $1,096** (prices from BOM_v4 sources; some ESTIMATEs). Everything is reused in the full robot except the bench PSU.

**What it proves on real hardware:**
- joint strength and belt behaviour
- KX couplings under real loads
- the shoulder balancer
- hand accuracy with the joint encoders (target ≤ 1 mm)
- the fin-ray grasp
- the cartridge-swap time
